topics.description: Medicaid fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with allegations of $9 billion in fraudulent claims. The investigation is ongoing, with Governor Walz and Attorney General Ellison testifying before the House Oversight Committee.
topics.reason: Recent testimony and allegations of knowledge of fraud

topics.description: The Feeding Our Future program is under investigation for alleged fraud, with the latest suspect receiving the most child care assistance funds in Minnesota in 2025.
